generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

The Tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate in the prescribed format with Indent Number ( work done certificates without indent number are directly libale for rejection ) from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Certificate/Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year(both days inclusive).

The Tenderer shall scan the Original Ownership Documents/ Lease/ Hire commitment Agreement for the Machinery and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
The defect liability period for this work is 365 days
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal.
The rates of all the items appeared in Bill of Quantities are inclusive of all leads and lifts
The contractor shall bound to comply the prevailing rules and regulations with regard to the EPF rules and any modifications before and after execution of agreement
After the award of the contract, the contractor has to furnish the details in respect of labour employed and the EPF details for this work in every RA bill.
Bidders are advised to note that , 18% GST will be added to the contract amount.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
The bidder should mention the UDIN No on the turnover certificate, failing which bid is rejected.
If the bidder uploaded the false document while participating in the tender, the bidder will be responsible and action will be initiated as per the tender clause.
The work should be completed in 09(Nine) Months ( including monsoon)

In respect of work costing more than Rs. 1.00 crore, the contractor shall establish field laboratory at his cost with requisite equipment or as stipulated in the Agreement. As per Approved QAP from Qualitty Assuarance Department
The tendered shall upload the Line of Credit issued from bank and obtained on bank letter head, same to be uploaded in portal otherwise it will be liable for rejection.

EMD of Rs 12,58,000.00 is to be paid, Rs. 1,00,000/- on e payment and Rs.11,58,000/- shall be in favour of the Executive Engineer Electrical, Kalaburagi,may be in the form of Bank Guarantee in the prescribed format obtained from any Nationalised / Scheduled Bank, pledges to the Executive Engineer Electrical, in Chief Engineer, Communication & Buildings Office, PWD North-East Zone Kalaburagi. If the Bidder fails to submit the original Bank Gaurantee at the time of Tender Opening, the Bid will be rejected.

The entire work shall be carried out under the direct supervision of and Sub Division Assistant Engineer(El), Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele.) Executive Engineer (Elect). In all cases of differences, disputes, etc., regarding the interpretation of specification of condition in general with any of the work, the decision of E.E.(Elec) PWD Kalaburgi, shall be final and binding on the contractor.
All items unit to be read as per UNI-SR Paricular (2023-24 continued to 2025-26)
The value of completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
Verification of All past expiriences to be considered excluding GST
The responsibility of safe custody of electrical equipments/ materials, etc., shall be with the contractor until they are finally handed over to the Department.
The cable trench and laying shall be executed as per ISS No.1255-1967 duly taking all necessary precaution.
Whenever executing authority insist proof of having purchased the materials (used during executing the work) for verification. The contractor shall produce the purchase bills.

The contractor shall guarantee all the materials supplied by him including erection, electrification work for trouble free top class performance and against manufacturing defects, for a period of one year from the date of satisfactory completion and commissioning. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for rectifying defects/replacement of defective materials immediately on receipt of intimation from executing authority and power supply shall be restored. Failure of which, action will be taken to get the work rectification through other agency at the cost and risk of the contractor.
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor.
The Bidder should furnish Name and Address Telephone Nos. Fax Nos. and email ID of the Tenderers Bankers detail.
During the execution of, any Minor Civil works or any other works are to be executed it has to be done by the Reputed firms/Tenderer, from his end without any charges.

The tenderer should be Solar PV Modules Manufacturer / MNRE channel Partner / Solar System integrator with Valid Registration of Establishment Certificate along with Udyam registration certificate / Incorporation Certificate with Udyam registration Certificate and should have suitable technical, financial & management capabilities.

It is the responsibility of the successfull bidder obtain approval for Net metering with grid synchronization and get statutory approval from Karnataka Renewable Energy Department (KREDL), GESCOM, Electrical Inspectorate, Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission( KERC), etc for the Solar Roof Top Syatem installation duly obtaining approval as necessary. However the department will pay the deposit / statutory fees if any after hearing the respective statutory bodies.

The successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a Security Deposit in the form of NSC/BG/FDR in the name of the Executive Engineer Electrical , PWD Kalaburgi, given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the conditions of contract.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to the extent.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer Electrical, Office of the Chief Engineer PWD North-East Zone, Kalaburgi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will hold good in lieu of the dates mentioned.
The Tenderer must submit the Certification of registration in the Labour department with the latest renewal.

Solar PV modules shall be manufactured using cells listed under ALMM List-II and modules listed under ALMM List-I as per latest MNRE guidelines. The Solar PV Modules shall be DCR-compliant modules only, conforming to all technical specifications and standards stipulated in the attached tender document.

Inspection and Testing Conditions Purchaser reserves the right to inspect the manufacturing facility. Random modules & other items involved in the work shall be selected for third-party testing. Modules & other items failing specifications shall be rejected.

Domestic Content Requirement (DCR): The Solar PV Modules supplied under this contract shall be Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) compliant. The modules shall be manufactured in India using domestically manufactured solar cells and modules in accordance with the latest MNRE guidelines and Government of India notifications applicable on the date of supply.

The bidder shall submit list of Solar PV Modules & allied equipments listed in the latest applicable MNRE Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) and complying with all relevant BIS, IEC and MNRE requirements for approval.
Any module found to be non-DCR compliant shall be liable for rejection and replacement at the contractors cost.

The bidder/manufacturer shall ensure that the offered solar PV modules are duly registered on the NISE DCR Portal and shall furnish documentary proof of such registration at the time of supply. The bidder shall provide the unique registration details, module traceability records, and any other information required by the Purchaser for verification through the NISE portal.

The makes, models and manufacturers of all materials/equipment proposed for use in this work shall be subject to approval during execution of the work and shall conform to the latest MNRE guidelines, standards and applicable Government regulations prevailing at the time of supply. The Executive Engineer (Electrical) reserves the right to approve or reject any make, model or manufacturer proposed by the contractor. The decision of the Executive Engineer (Electrical) in this regard shall be final and binding on the bidder.

All manufacturer warranties pertaining to the equipment and materials supplied under this work shall be transferred to and held in the name of the Executive Engineer (Electrical). The contractor shall submit original warranty certificates and ensure that all warranty obligations are directly enforceable by the Executive Engineer (Electrical) during the warranty period

The contractor shall submit the original test certificates issued by the respective manufacturers for all equipment/materials supplied under the work, along with copies of the corresponding invoices, as a prerequisite for processing and release of payment

The bidder shall make necessary arrangements for inspection of the manufacturers factory and major equipment/materials proposed for use in the work, as and when directed by the department. All costs associated with facilitating such inspections shall be borne by the bidder

All necessary drawings, paper works, documents, etc required for liason to obtain approval for Net metering with grid synchronization from GESCOM and other statutory approval from Karnataka Renewable Energy Department (KREDL), Electrical Inspectorate, Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission( KERC), etc for the Solar Roof Top Syatem installation duly obtaining approval shall be the responsibility of contractor.
The Annual Maintenance shall commence from the date after successfull completion of DLP / Warranty. The Annual Maintenance period is for 2years

As per tender document the contractor / supplier shall attach scanned copy of part-2 EMD such as Bank Guarantee along with the bid on e-procurement online portal and submit the Original Bank Guarantee on before the last date and time notified in the tender document to the tender inviting authority. The tenders shall be evaluated only on confirmation of receipt of payment of EMD. As per G.O PWD :35 : RDF : 2010 : Bangalore Dated: 24.06.2014
